videos.title: Don't sleep on the Pixel 11
videos.description:
With the hardware practically unchanged, the Pixel 11 is a bargain for what is actually new with Google's latest lineup for Pixel phones. While it’s $400 more than the Pixel 10A, it has a faster processor, more RAM and storage, Qi2 charging, and a telephoto lens plus access to the new Camera Looks and Magic Capture features.

videos.description:

We discuss if HiLight is a LowLight, whether we miss the temperature sensor, and if the Watch 5’s GPS truly beats Garmin and Apple. And stay tuned for more camera discussion on Friday’s Vergecast.
